question: If P ∶ Q = 3 ∶ 2, then find the ratio (P² - Q²) ∶ (P² + Q²).
solution:
Given:

P ∶ Q = 3 ∶ 2

Calculation:

P : Q = 3 : 2

⇒ P² : Q² = 9 : 4 (Squaring both sides)

⇒ (P² + Q²)/(P² - Q²) = (9 + 4)/(9 - 4) (Using componendo-dividendo method)

⇒ (P2 + Q2)/(P2 - Q2) = 13/5

⇒ (P2 - Q2)/(P2 + Q2) = 5/13

⇒ (P2 - Q2) : (P2 + Q2) = 5 : 13

**∴ (P2 - Q2) ∶ (P2 + Q2) is equal to 5 : 13.**
